measured_mechanism.explanation: The D3 conjunction native_table_structure_failed AND (native_table_unverifiable OR native_table_header_unattributed) AND attempts is entirely a verdict on the NATIVE lane, but the branch replaced the WHOLE page with a zero-content marker. Cochrane-Piazzesi p15 (--agentic --no-native-first) shipped 100 chars / 0 decimals while a 2546-char gemini attempt (36 decimals), judged faithful against the page image by two independent judges, sat in the same page's attempts. Prose and equations went with it. The floor's premise -- a wrong number is worse than a missing one -- has no force when a scored reading of the page already exists.

second_site.what: _phase_assemble's d3_floor_pages was derived from flags alone, so after the manifest change it would have counted a page under a disposition it no longer has.

fix.keep_rules: non-native engine, non-empty text, parseable grid via find_table_blocks, not PageStatus.ERROR, not FailureMode.HALLUCINATION, text is not itself a failure marker, scanned_table_evidence_failed not set. Last qualifying attempt in ladder order (most escalated rung).
fix.why_lower_bar_than_259: flagged_model_page_output chooses between a flagged model reading and a COMPLETE native reading, so it can insist on REJECTION_AMBIGUOUS_DEFERRED and fall back safely. Here the alternative is a marker with zero content, so 'we do not know why this rung was refused' cannot justify shipping nothing.
fix.audit_passed: NEVER touched. Demotion is on a dataclasses.replace() copy via status/failure_mode. Guarded by test_best_output_winner_is_not_mutated.
fix.no_multiset_oracle: No numeric-multiset or decimal-count comparison anywhere in the change or its tests. Assertions are the issue's: which text shipped, and its status.

non_table_content_preservation.mechanism: The kept attempt's WHOLE text ships -- prose, equations and grid together -- rather than a table splice. That is why the measured page's prose and equations return.
non_table_content_preservation.test: test_non_table_content_survives_the_table_verdict asserts two prose sentences and a LaTeX equation body separately from the grid.
non_table_content_preservation.stated_limit: When NO attempt authored a grid the marker still ships, so a page's model prose is still lost there. That is required by the reverse guard in the brief; splicing native prose out of a region whose geometry verification hard-failed would risk shipping the collapsed table as prose. Flagged to the owner as a possible follow-up, not done here.
